pages.lesson:
LESSON: SELF- AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: question(s) Creation
Topic 1.1: Self- Awareness

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Self- Awareness. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what they like about themselves God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. state what they like about 4 lessons
2. appreciate their physical appearance as uniquely created by God
3. state different chores they do at home as service to God
4. appreciate their worth as part of God’s creation

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. state what they like about 4 lessons
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state what they like about 4 lessons. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate their physical appearance as uniquely created by God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate their physical appearance as uniquely created by God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. state different chores they do at home as service to God
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to state different chores they do at home as service to God. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. appreciate their worth as part of God’s creation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate their worth as part of God’s creation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Self- Awareness.
2. Explain Self- Awareness to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Self- Awareness.
4. Show that you can: state what they like about 4 lessons
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Self- Awareness. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what they like about themselves God?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. state what they like about 4 lessons
2. appreciate their physical appearance as uniquely created by God
3. state different chores they do at home as service to God
4. appreciate their worth as part of God’s creation

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
